name: LogsInventoryCard
srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — checked line by line and every difference is by construction. PARAMETERIZATION: selectedStream/onViewStream/flash carry defaults so the record renders with no props. DATA SUBSTITUTION: the file drives everything through Tauri commands the preview has no backend for — refresh() awaits invoke("list_log_files"), clear() awaits invoke("clear_log")/invoke("perf_clear_history"), exportStream() awaits invoke("export_log") — so the record holds SAMPLE_FILES and stubs each handler to the flash() message the real one would produce. The render is otherwise identical. It missed the automatic render-layer check only because those stubbed handlers sit INSIDE JSX attributes, which changes the markup lines without changing the markup. One residual, deliberate: the file gained a refreshTrigger prop, which has no meaning in a preview that never refreshes. Hand-reviewed.
